newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchants Hai Hong to be renamed.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants Hai Hong to be renamed.

text.p: China Merchants Hai Hong Holdings Co Ltd said it would be renamed China Merchants Holdings (International) Co Ltd and increase its authorised share capital after approval by its shareholders on Thursday.
Shareholders approved an increase in the company's authorised share capital from HK$120 million to HK$200 million by the creation of 800 million shares, it said in a statement.
The shareholders also approved the acquisition of an interest in five highway projects in China and in a mainland container manufacturing concern, it said.
The acquisition plans were announced in April.
The company also said Sun Yin had been appointed as the group's managing director.
Sun, 59, is currently executive director and financial controller of the China Merchants Group and vice-chairman of Union Bank of Hong Kong Ltd, it said.
